Our Story

Direct from Italian ateliers, no middlemen.

Crown Times was founded to close the distance between Italy's watchmaking regions and Sri Lankan collectors. We travel, source, and import every piece ourselves — so what reaches you is genuine, verified, and fairly priced.

No grey-market resellers. No guesswork. Just honest timepieces with proper documentation and after-sales support here in Sri Lanka.
